Twenty years of
your money life.
Four minutes a day.

You start at 22 with your first salary. Every day you play one month: a few decisions, then you see what the month did. There are no right answers, only consequences.

Every choice pays out later, sometimes two years later
You are tracked on four things: what you are worth, how safe you are, how free you are, and how much you are living
No real money. Nothing to buy. It is a simulation
Begin at 22

Educational simulation. Not investment advice.
